An error boundary catches errors in descendant rendering and certain lifecycle work, and renders fallback
UI. It does not generally catch event-handler or arbitrary async errors.

එකක් Jපන්වන්න boundary එකක් භාවිත කරනවා.

Interview question: Can an error boundary catch an ordinary onClick error?
Answer: Not generally; handle event and async errors in their own code.
